canonical_aliases._doc: Structured form of pmoves/docs/operations/CANONICAL_NAMES.md. The audit gate (pmoves/scripts/audit_naming_drift.py) reads this block first and falls back to the markdown only when this block is absent. When a canonical decision changes, update both surfaces. Each entry: aliases (deprecated names accepted in fallback chains during sunset window), sunset (ISO date or condition), severity (P0/P1/P2 from sitrep), reference (markdown section).

MCP_SERVER_TOKEN.sunset: compose drops empty default; env_file authoritative

NATS_URL.sunset: drop embedded password fallback in compose
